traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Structure meets dream. Grounding imagination into reality, or pessimism colliding with illusion. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Dreams worked patiently into something real. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize limit and imagination into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what limit and imagination have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Disciplined vision realized over time; the task is managing fear.
shadow: The ease lets fear and rigidity and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.

readerCopy.body: If something matters enough that you want to keep giving your time or energy to it, the next question is what would make that commitment possible on an ordinary week rather than only when you feel inspired. When Saturn sextiles Neptune, a hope or compassionate impulse can become more sustainable because you are willing to give it limits, time, money, or a routine that protects it from depending on your best mood. You do not need to build the whole vision at once. Choose the part you can genuinely support now and let consistency give the larger idea something solid to grow from.
